Day 3	Activity	12.01.2026					Rovaniemi: Small-Group Northern Lights Tour - Meeting point: Safari office in Maakuntakatu 29, Rovaniemi - Time: 8:00 pm - 12:00 am - With this intimate small group setting, you get to partake in the region's premier Northern Lights hunting experience. Our knowledgeable, English-speaking Aurora Borealis guide will lead the way. To ensure your comfort, we provide protective winter clothing, including overalls and boots, and a steaming cup of hot blueberry juice to keep you warm. Please remember to bring your own food or snacks. Includes: Pick-up/drop off within a 15 km distance from Rovaniemi city center, Knowledgeable, English-speaking Aurora Borealis guide, Protective winter clothing: overalls and boots, Refreshing hot blueberry juice to keep you warm
							
Day 4	Activity	13.01.2026					Rovaniemi: Arctic Circle Highlights - Meeting point: Arctic Circle Snowmobile Park City Office - Time: 8:45 am - 2:45 pm - Enjoy a full day of arctic experiences in Rovaniemi with the huskies and reindeers, visit Santa Claus himself, and make unforgettable memories in Rovaniemi! Your day will start with transfer to the farm, where you will be able to ride your own reindeer sledge in a brief, 500m long ride. Your newly learned skills will be rewarded with a Reindeer Sledge Driver’s License! Next, make your way to the Alaskan Huskies where you will find these beautiful, loyal, and energetic companions. Experience the Alaskan Huskies in action on a 500m long sleigh ride. Enjoy a traditional salmon soup lunch during your visit and listen to the local reindeer herders as they tell you more about the herding lifestyle and how it is to be a reindeer herder in the 21st century. While visiting Reindeer Manor, children under 150cm can try mini snowmobiling for 10 minutes on our mini-track. After the farm visit, you will be taken to the Santa Claus Village where you will have some free time to explore at your own pace. You have the opportunity to experience the Christmas atmosphere, step across the Arctic Circle, meet Santa Claus. Your day will conclude with drop-off back to Rovaniemi. Includes: Transfer from the City Center of Rovaniemi, Lunch: Traditional salmon soup (Vegetarian option available), Winter clothes (overall, boots and gloves), Alaskan Husky visit with 500m sleigh ride (4 pax), Reindeer Farm visit with 500m sleigh ride (2-3 pax), Reindeer driver license, Approximately 2 hours free time in Santa Claus Village

Day 4	Activity	13.01.2026					Rovaniemi: Ice Floating under the Northern Lights - Meeting point: Safari office, Maakuntakatu 29, Rovaniemi - Time: 7:30 pm - 11:30 pm - Experience one of the most unique and relaxing ways to view the Northern Lights. Float around in the icy waters of one of Finland's lakes and just go with the flow. Includes: Floatation survival suit, Snacks and blueberry tea, English-speaking guide

Day 7	Activity	16.01.2026					Tromsø: Reindeer Sledding, Reindeer Feeding and Sami Culture - Meeting time: 09:45 (9.45 am) in front of Radisson Blue hotel main entrance Radisson Blu Hotel (Sjøgata 7, 9259 Tromsø) Time: 10:00 am - 2:30 pm - Get to know our herd of 150 reindeer and join on a 30 minute sled ride while enjoying our beautiful, untouched Arctic nature and the Lyngen Alps on the horizon! Includes: Scenic transfers (45 min each way), Knowledgeable English-speaking guide, Entrance to the fence and feeding the herd on our camp, Reindeer Sledding for 30 minutes approximately.,  Hot drinks and hot meal (traditional Sámi stew or vegetarian option), Stories about the life and culture of the Sámi people
Day 7	Leisure	16.01.2026					Tromsø: Spend time at leisure
Day 7	Activity	16.01.2026					Tromsø: Northern Lights Cruise with Silent Electric Ship - Meeting point: Walk to Skarven Kro, Kaigata 6, Tromsø - Time: 7:00 pm - 10:00 pm - Embark on a journey into the profound darkness of the Arctic fjords and Polar nights. We leave Tromsø behind and navigate towards the area with the most promising weather conditions for the night. This could be northwards to Kvaløyvågen, southwards to Ramfjorden, or westwards along the southern part of Kvaløya island. Includes: Departure from central Tromsø, 3-hour fjord cruise, Light meal (soup and bread) and water, English speaking guides, Warm indoor saloons Free wifi, Toilets
							
Day 8	Activity	17.01.2026					Tromsø: Fjellheisen Cable Car Round-Trip Gondola Tickets - Self transfer to and from Fjellheisen Cable Car, Sollivegen 12, Tromsø - Timing: Flexible - Travel with the mountain lift up and down, you decide for yourself how long you want to be on the mountain within our opening hours.We drive every full and half hour, we do not all get up on the first trip, we drive the next fast as possible. Includes: Return ticket for Fjellheisen Cable Car, Flexible departure and return times

Day 8	Activity	17.01.2026					Tromsø: Northern Lights Chase with Pro Photographer - Meeting point: Walk to Safari office at Roald Amundsens plass 1A, Tromsø - Time: 6:00 pm - 12:00 am - On this tour you will go chasing lights the whole time. This means that if the sky is cloudy, we will move from place to place until we find a clear spot to see the Aurora. We may take you all the way to Finland! Includes: Professional, English-speaking Aurora photographer guides, Transportation by comfortable minibus, van or coach, Help with camera settings and Aurora Borealis photography, Hot drinks and cookies
